releaseNotes: Replaces the non-working 0.12.29 note-delete handler with a self-contained BOOX-safe delete controller
The delete button is captured on pointerdown, shows a LuMa confirmation dialog and performs the localStorage mutation directly after confirmation
After deletion the Notes editor is rerendered from persisted state and Notes remains the active screen
Does not touch the hardware-confirmed fullscreen mode, editor, colors, resize or Pen/Marker option separation
